description: Land Title Settlement Department - Digampataha, Dambulla D/S Division, Matale District - Cad. Map No. 310019
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, owner details, extent of land, and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership registration and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
